audit.title: ALT RADAR production archive data-coverage audit

definitions.usable_rows: distinct timestamps with a parseable ts and numeric o/h/l/c/vol/amt after sort+dedup; identical to proto.quant.bars.load_coin output
definitions.malformed: unparseable ts, short row, non-numeric o/h/l/c, non-positive o/h/l/c, h<l, h<max(o,c), l>min(o,c)
definitions.gap: a step between consecutive (sorted, de-duplicated) bars that is not 300 s
definitions.complete_day: a UTC day in which all 288 five-minute slots are present
definitions.watcher_stale: lag_bars_vs_btc > stale_coin_bars (3), i.e. the engine's proto/quant/engine.py:437 rule
definitions.flag_complete: dev window: no gaps, no malformed price rows, and not watcher-stale
definitions.flag_partial: dev window: has rows but has gaps / malformed rows / is stale
definitions.flag_insufficient: dev window: fewer than 288 usable rows (< 1 complete day)

attribution_windows.sample_selection: every floor(n/60)-th coin of the sorted bar universe

splits.source: proto/quant/config.py Splits (frozen defaults of QuantConfig DEFAULT)
splits.n_days_argument_source: measured archive span (last bar - first bar)/86400
splits.note: These are the CONFIGURED boundaries (Splits.bounds) evaluated against the measured archive span. They are not evidence about the data, and the holdout end is 'the end of the data', which for a live, still-appending archive is a moving boundary.
